a.lede: If you share Spotify sub with family, you may need to scan QR code to prove it.
a.title: Spotify ramps up policy enforcement on family plans

b.lede: Spotify told investors its rollout of QR code verification to ensure Family Plan members live in the same household is not a "crackdown," just a routine improvement.
b.title: Spotify confirms Family Plan crackdown, but calls it a ‘routine improvement’
